# CANDIDATE: STRUCTURE_VIX_BAND_REVERSAL_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-09-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger

## Hypothesis
A new higher high (HH) combined with elevated VIX (>20) and a rejection wick (long upper wick bar closing below HH) signals distribution for a short opportunity. This edge exists because in high-VIX regimes, failure to sustain a breakout after VIX contraction indicates weakening bullish momentum and seller dominance, particularly after a VIX spike followed by contraction.

## Mechanism
Entry: Enter short when price makes a new HH, VIX > 20, and then forms a long upper wick bar (upper wick ≥ 2× body) that closes below the HH level, with ATR expansion (>1.5× 20-day average ATR).  
Exit: Chart-stop above HH (price > HH + 1 ATR); TP1 at 1.5R short; trail via premium-stop at 2R as price moves favorable.
